steps.prompt: Is the person unconscious, not breathing normally, having a seizure, or do you suspect a large amount was ingested?

Call emergency services immediately. If not breathing and trained, begin CPR. Place an unconscious person in the recovery position. Do NOT induce vomiting unless specifically instructed by emergency services.
steps.cta: Call emergency services — recovery position, do not induce vomiting

steps.prompt: Call emergency services or a Poison Control centre immediately, even if the person seems well. Have these ready: what was taken, how much, and when. Keep them calm and do not give anything to eat or drink.
Do NOT induce vomiting unless Poison Control explicitly instructs you to. Vomiting can cause additional harm with certain poisons, especially corrosives or petroleum products.
Keep the substance or its container — the label will help emergency staff identify the poison and the correct treatment. If they vomit, turn them on their side to prevent choking.
steps.cta: Keep container label and follow Poison Control instructions
